fusions.name: Hammering Downdraft
fusions.desc: Beats a downdraft into a cone 4.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and driving it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flicked Pinion
fusions.desc: Flicks a feather into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Weightless
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and lifts you 3 tiles from where you stood. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
